title: Sky-Bridge Market
brief: a sky-bridge market spanning two cores, with stalls and lanterns

footprint.note: occupies the 4x2 gap between two core faces at any level; the deck top is the anchor level

requires.note: core faces exactly 4 cells apart, both >= 2 cells wide
each core must have a landing at the anchor level

placement.daylight: prefers open sky or a light well (+20% footfall in daylight)

capacity.note: ten back-to-back stalls on a central spine, five facing each aisle

transit.note: counts as a walkway between the two cores

food.note: street food; draws on stratum food supply

light_air.note: thin deck casts a narrow shadow on the level below

construction.name: trusses
construction.action: bolt two lattice trusses between the core faces (they carry everything)

construction.name: deck
construction.action: lay the timber deck on the trusses; it bears on both cores

construction.name: gates
construction.action: raise the gate posts and hang the neon gate signs

construction.name: stalls
construction.action: set ten back-to-back stalls along the central spine, awnings meeting in a ridge

construction.name: lanterns
construction.action: hang the lantern strings between the gate posts along both railings and connect the power
